status: Four controls and four reserved checks identified before physical fitting/scoring; no predicted coordinate used as observation.

points.label: Kidston Island
points.identity_evidence: Elongated Kidston Island directly offshore Baddeck, east of the cove and west of Red Point; northeastern lighthouse end and broad southwestern body correspond. Lighthouse/text excluded.

points.label: Hume Island
points.identity_evidence: Small Hume Island in St Patricks Channel east of western shore, north of Bell Rock and northwest of MacIvor Point. Separate closed island, not the point or shore road. Historical outline is only about 70 native pixels long.

points.label: Northeastern Bird Island (Ciboux)
points.identity_evidence: Northeastern of the two long Bird Islands, offshore Cape Dauphin, with lighthouse and intervening small rocks toward the southwestern member. Whole coast centroid, small terminal detached rocks excluded.

points.label: Eastern Baddeck Lake basin

source_frame.derivation: Native subcrop of VM05 at offset [780,350], no resampling

points.identity_evidence: Eastern basin in the named Baddeck Lakes group, east of the much larger lobed western lake, north of the outlet pond and northwest of narrow McLeod Lake. Distinct northward horn and broad southern body. Inlet streams and connector pond excluded.

points.label: Southwestern Bird Island (Hertford)
points.identity_evidence: Southwestern long Bird Island, separated from northeastern lighthouse island by a string of small rocks. Native polygon follows whole coastline, not label. Spatially correlated with the Ciboux control; only checks this local pair.

points.label: McLeod Lake
points.identity_evidence: Long narrow north-south McLeod Lake on the west side of the St Anns road/mountain ridge, southeast of the Baddeck Lakes. Western tributary and southern Christopher Meadow outlet distinguish it from the eastern Baddeck basin; source lake displacement is not corrected to guide.

points.label: Bone Island
points.identity_evidence: Isolated Bone Island just north of the eastern St Patricks Channel headland and southeast of Stony Island; three-way shore/island context supports identity. Small historical outline and historical/modern shape generalization retained.

points.label: Stony Island
points.identity_evidence: Small Stony Island off the north shore of St Patricks Channel, northwest of Bone Island and below the mapped road. Same southern channel locality as Bone, not an independent region.
